State set of normal mode

Source: R/caller.R
normal_state_set.Rd

Resolves params$states_normal (caller_defaults()) to a caller_states() set: "normal", "normal_att" (opt-in: loss and CN-LOH over f_att_normal) or "auto": normal_att when the features' phasing regime (phasing["detected"], the run-level rule of detect_phasing() that cell_features() records in features$phasing) is chromosome, i.e. merged chromosome-scale phase sets, whose switch errors attenuate the oriented fraction of a real event under any orientation; normal on block phasing, without a phasing record and without allele votes (the allelic terms are 0, so both sets score alike). Mixed regimes (some chromosomes in blocks, phasing_by_chrom()) follow the run-level regime: the state set is one per run, not per chromosome.

Usage

normal_state_set(params = caller_defaults(), phasing = NULL, votes = TRUE)

Arguments

params

caller_defaults() (states_normal, f_att_normal)

phasing

the features' phasing record (features$phasing: named detected, orientation) or NULL

votes

FALSE when the run has no allele votes

Value

list(set = "normal" or "normal_att", requested, reason): reason is the text of the run note
